*(NGC 4631，也稱為鯨魚星系或科德韋爾32，是位於獵犬座以側面向著我們的螺旋星系。這個星系扭曲成的契形使它的外觀看起來像鯡魚或鯨魚，因此有了這個暱稱。因為這個鄰近的星系是以側面向著地球，專業天文學家可以更好的理解恆星在星系盤面外的分布。...)*
*(NGC 4631 (also known as the Whale Galaxy or Caldwell 32) is a  barred spiral galaxy in the constellation Canes Venatici about 30 million light years away from Earth. It was discovered on 20 March 1787 by German-British astronomer William Herschel. This galaxy's slightly distorted wedge shape gives it the appearance of a herring or a whale, hence its nickname.  Because this nearby galaxy is seen edge-on from Earth, professional astronomers observe this galaxy to better understand the gas and stars located outside the plane of the galaxy....The Hockey Stick Galaxy is a warped barred spiral galaxy also known as NGC 4656, located 30 million light-years away in the constellation Canes Venatici. Its bent, stick-like shape with a curved end comes from a gravitational pull with nearby neighbors.)*
